methodology.priorWarning: Hypothetical independent-factor prior, conditioned on successful compilation; not observed usage. No forced deduplication.
methodology.stressTracks: 20 blueprints × 5 tracks; 40 searches over supported 30/45/60/75/90-minute choices retain all rejected contexts. No malformed-input tests. No failed program is replaced.
methodology.timing: Three warm in-process compilations per program; sample median. Not a browser/end-to-end or hardware benchmark.
methodology.oracleLimitations: Numeric bounds and day labels independent; slot constraints, time and weeks partially use compiler metadata. No training-outcome proof.
